title: Exhaustive-match tests enforce enum shape at compile time
description: ClientError (error.rs), SseEvent (sse.rs), and WsFrame (ws/mod.rs) each have a test containing an exhaustive match with no wildcard arm. These tests do not assert runtime behavior; their purpose is to fail to compile if a new variant is added. The comment on the ClientError test states: 'this match will fail to compile if RateLimited is ever reintroduced'. A contributor might remove these as 'no-op tests that don't assert anything useful'. They are useful precisely because they are compile-time guards: they prevent variants from being silently added (which would break match exhaustiveness elsewhere) without forcing the adder to deliberately touch these tests. Do not remove or add _ wildcard arms to these tests.
